description: Reads and concatenates content from RAG cache files returned by rag-checker. Truncates each file to a configurable head size to fit context windows.

files.description: List of file paths to read (typically output of rag-checker)

max_files.description: Cap on files to actually read (prevents context overflow)

head_lines.description: Lines to read from the top of each file

separator.description: Template for the separator inserted between files. Use {filename} as placeholder.

content.description: Concatenated content of all scanned files with separators
